name: dialog
description: The one dialog in the product: delete everything. A scrim over the screen with a card centred on the page. If a second dialog appears, something has gone wrong (direction-lock.md §6 G2).

labelledBy.description: The id of the card heading that names the dialog (aria-labelledby).

places.block: the dialog's card: the page gutter

states.default: yes: open, as rendered (the comps show it open; closed is not rendered)
states.hover: n/a: the scrim is not interactive; the card's actions carry their own states
states.focus-visible: n/a: focus moves into the card's actions (createDialog)
states.loading: n/a: a pending delete is its own screen (/you/data/deleting)
states.error: yes: the card carries a status paragraph (the failed-delete state)
states.empty: n/a: a dialog without a card is not rendered

a11y.role: dialog, aria-modal="true", aria-labelledby the card's heading
a11y.keyboard: focus moves into the card on open, Tab is trapped, Escape closes and focus returns to the trigger. In the comps this behaviour lives in createDialog (design system/components/journal-components.js); it moves into a dialog.js module script with the composite wave.

responsive.700: the scrim's left padding includes the rail, so the card centres on the page rather than on the app (revision 24)

changelog.change: Converted from lock.css G2 .dialog. Sets the card's --aj-c-card-measure-wide to 38ch (revision 26).

catalogue.note: The dialog covers its container; the catalogue frame stands in for the app.
